primary_background_source.role: Independent researcher report describing Java Myth credential-record schemas and native NSS/CNG recovery architecture. Family attribution across these variants is an inference; the report is not an exact-hash match and does not establish the encrypted ac865 payload.

reviews.label: bad
reviews.reason: Dedicated browser/Discord secret collector: actual JVM records describe URL/username/password, scoped cookies, and payment-card number/CVV; a typed enum groups PASSWORD, COOKIE, DISCORD, AUTOFILL, HISTORY and EXTENSION. Bundled native interfaces expose NSS_Init/PK11SDR_Decrypt, NCryptDecrypt and NtOpenProcessToken. Together these establish multi-source secret recovery; unresolved protected call details do not provide a realistic ordinary-application explanation.
reviews.assessment_limit_or_rejected_explanation: A password-manager import feature does not explain the combined Discord/session collection taxonomy, complete browser-secret models, and protected native recovery architecture.

hostile_traits.description: Myth browser and Discord secret-collection model

reviews.label: bad
reviews.reason: The embedded DiscordWebhook library accepts a caller-supplied webhook and uses it for text messages, but both attachment overloads construct HttpPost with the same embedded foreign receiver. They read caller-provided files into multipart bodies and execute that request. This diverts attachments away from the configured destination.
reviews.assessment_limit_or_rejected_explanation: A normal webhook client would send attachments to its configured destination. Silent redirection is implemented here; the signature is deliberately limited to the reviewed receiver and upload profile.

hostile_traits.description: Webhook diverts attachments to embedded receiver

reviews.label: good
reviews.realistic_benign_explanation: Dependency bootstrap/cache helper for a Java application using JNA, SQLite JDBC and global input hooks.
reviews.reason: Static transcription of both string layers resolves all four URL/filename pairs to public JNA, jna-platform, SQLite JDBC and system-hook releases. The class checks/copies those files and hands their URL/path pairs to a helper; it implements no key recording, credential theft or payload execution.
reviews.assessment_limit_or_rejected_explanation: The outer two-key transform is inferred from all eight coherent URL/filename results; its helper is absent. This ruling covers the standalone dependency helper, not its parent application.

reviews.label: inconclusive
reviews.realistic_benign_explanation: An obfuscated Java settings or licensing module containing encrypted constants and an obfuscator-demo expiry check.
reviews.reason: Five encrypted string values and their consumer are unavailable. The visible class is a settings holder with a demo guard; it contains no collection or control implementation. The concrete unresolved values prevent confidently identifying either a malicious configuration or a benign one.
reviews.assessment_limit_or_rejected_explanation: This is a realistic benign use for the observed class, not confirmation of the missing settings or application.

reviews.label: inconclusive
reviews.realistic_benign_explanation: A shutdown/crash notification thread that posts an application lifecycle event to a monitoring service.
reviews.reason: The thread only calls Main.post(Main.URL, Main.exitBy, ""). Main.post, the destination and event semantics are absent. A lifecycle callback explains the visible code; no command dispatch, secret collection or malicious endpoint is established.
reviews.assessment_limit_or_rejected_explanation: The missing parent callback prevents confirming the ordinary telemetry interpretation or identifying an implant notification.

reviews.label: inconclusive
reviews.realistic_benign_explanation: A protected GUI application packer or native application wrapper bundling a packaged Windows program.
reviews.reason: The archive contains Swing/AWT UI classes, a Packer JNI binding, a native PE-loading library and an encrypted c.bin resource. The native symbols establish in-memory PE loading, but the encrypted program and protected Java call targets remain unresolved. They could contain a hostile payload; it is not established from the recovered content.
reviews.assessment_limit_or_rejected_explanation: Generic packing is a realistic benign mechanism. The Myth namespace association is corroboration, not proof of the encrypted payload, and does not justify inventing a hostile flow.

reviews.label: inconclusive
reviews.realistic_benign_explanation: A Java download/bootstrap applet that fetches a user-visible media or application file in the background.
reviews.reason: The applet reads fileName/url parameters and starts an absent Main$1 worker automatically, while painting a play-style icon. Automatic downloading and the icon are concerning, but the missing worker and payload prevent distinguishing an ordinary content bootstrapper from a fake-player drive-by. No exploit or execution implementation is present in this leaf.
reviews.assessment_limit_or_rejected_explanation: A fake-player downloader remains a serious alternative. Collector paths are not evidence of an exploit implementation.
